description: ADR 0033 §1 (PROTOCOL 18.11): pqdc = ML-DSA-65.Sign(account_ml_sk, utf8("z-device-pq-v1:") || acct || ded || dx || SHA-256(sealEk)), the account's attestation that a sealing key belongs to a device — fixed width, 143 bytes — for the root device and a linked one, signed deterministically (rnd = 0^32) so the bytes reproduce; production signing is hedged. Refused: each field changed (dx, ded, acct, the sealing key), another device's pqdc, either a byte short, and a forgery by an adversary holding every classical private key and no ML-DSA secret. The wire forms: a pqid carrying pqdc and the same pqid without it, a pqseal, pqs:1, and four pqseal members a reader ignores. Nothing sends any of it before 44.3.

devices.name: root
devices.note: the account's own device: ded is the account key

must_refuse.name: dx_swapped
must_refuse.why: the root device's pqdc, with the linked device's X25519 key as dx

must_refuse.name: ded_swapped
must_refuse.why: the root device's pqdc, with the linked device's Ed25519 key as ded

must_refuse.name: acct_swapped
must_refuse.why: the root device's pqdc, naming another account's key as acct

must_refuse.name: seal_key_swapped
must_refuse.why: the root device's pqdc, beside another sealing key (other_seal_ek)

must_refuse.name: other_devices_pqdc
must_refuse.why: the linked device's genuine pqdc, offered for the root device

must_refuse.name: pqdc_one_byte_short
must_refuse.why: the genuine pqdc a byte short

must_refuse.name: seal_ek_one_byte_short
must_refuse.why: the genuine pqdc beside its sealing key a byte short

must_refuse.name: classical_forgery
must_refuse.why: a device of the adversary's own (other_*), attested by an account key whose Ed25519 half is the genuine one and whose ML-DSA half is the adversary's (forger_ml_seed): it verifies under that key and not under the account's

pqseal_ignored.name: ek_coefficient_q
pqseal_ignored.why: FIPS 203 7.2, the modulus check: the first coefficient of t-hat at q

pqseal_ignored.name: ek_not_a_string
pqseal_ignored.why: a member of the wrong type
